verdict.rationale: PayPal's Subscriptions docs cover plans charging fixed or per-seat amounts at regular intervals, free or discounted trials, plan upgrades and downgrades, and automated payment recovery. Subscription create/update/cancel and plan create/list are also exposed as documented agent-toolkit tools. Missing for 10: any evidence of proration handling on plan changes, in-depth API-level documentation beyond overview pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
